channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Iran targets strategic U.S. assets in Kuwait, Bahrain after Egypt drone attack
item.description: Iran's army said it launched attacks on strategic U.S. assets and military bases in Kuwait and Bahrain.

item.title: Oil prices ease as recovering Hormuz Strait traffic tempers war premium
item.description: Commonwealth Bank of Australia said in a note on Friday that stronger oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz had eased market concerns after U.S.-Iran strikes earlier this week.

item.title: Amazon hikes 2026 capex to $220 billion due to higher memory costs
item.description: AWS sales expanded 37% year over year, which trounced analysts' expectations for 31% growth.

item.title: Deadly storms and a global supply squeeze are sending copper prices soaring
item.description: Deadly storms in Chile have disrupted mining operations, further straining supply and potentially driving prices higher, strategists say.

item.title: South Korea's 'bipolar' stock market: meltdowns, a record rally and what's to come
item.description: South Korea's stock market staged its sharpest reversal on record on Friday, capping a month of wild swings.

item.title: Here's where Jeffrey Gundlach is investing after the Fed held rates steady
item.description: DoubleLine Capital CEO Jeffrey Gundlach isn't taking big risks in the bond market right now.

item.title: AI investor Leopold Aschenbrenner forced to unwind all public stock positions after steep losses, sources say
item.description: Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund has sold all of its public stock holdings, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: BOJ holds rates at 1%, warns of core inflation exceeding 2% target
item.description: The decision comes as speculation continues to swirl around whether the Bank of Japan will hike rates at a faster pace.

item.title: CXMT's blockbuster debut in Shanghai sets stage for next test against global memory giants
item.description: The company faces a challenge as it does not have access to the latest extreme ultraviolet, or EUV, lithography machines, essential for manufacturing advanced chips.

item.title: Apple earnings takeaways: Weak forecast, supply concerns overshadow sales beat in Cook's last report as CEO
item.description: Apple reported third-quarter earnings on Thursday after the closing bell, and Tim Cook addressed investors for the last time as CEO.

item.title: Fast-fashion retailer Shein’s 3-year IPO odyssey may have cost it the ‘golden time’ to go public
item.description: Investors are questioning whether Beijing's blessing can carry a $40-billion-plus valuation for a clothing retailer whose growth engine is stalling.

item.title: From Hormuz to the Black Sea: Maritime battlefields are shaping ‘a new world order’
item.description: Attacks near the Strait of Hormuz, Red Sea and Black Sea are pushing shipowners to reroute cargo and rethink global trade risks.

item.title: China’s U.S.-bound shipments fall in July after brief recovery, survey shows
item.description: The latest China Beige Book study found factory activity decelerated in July.

item.title: SK Hynix shares surge 25%, while Samsung soars over 20% as AI rally roars back
item.description: South Korea's chip heavyweights SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics soared more than 20% on Friday, tracking a sharp rally in U.S. technology stocks.

item.title: McDonald's charts are starting to coil in the direction of a buy signal, Jay Woods says
item.description: Given low volatility on earnings day, a good support area and the fundamental story changing in much of the sector, McDonald's may be worth a quick stop.

item.title: Amazon soars after CEO Andy Jassy makes the case for its massive AI investment
item.description: Amazon jumped about 10% to $258 in after-hours trading, putting shares at their highest level since early June.

item.title: Trump promised a 'golden age' for agriculture. Farmers in Iowa say they're still waiting
item.description: President Donald Trump has promised a "golden age" for agriculture, but farmers in Iowa and elsewhere are struggling with tariffs and the Iran war.

item.title: Tim Cook sees Apple's hybrid AI strategy as a 'competitive weapon'
item.description: Ahead of the launch of Siri AI, Apple's outgoing CEO Tim Cook said the company will charge for artificial intelligence through iCloud.

item.title: Reddit shares sink 11% on 'choppy' search referrals even as results blow past estimates
item.description: Reddit reported second-quarter earnings that beat on the top and the bottom, and gave a revenue forecast that topped estimates.

item.title: China's factory activity unexpectedly contracts in July on demand slump, typhoons
item.description: China's factory activity unexpectedly contracted in July, as the export rush that powered a second-quarter rebound began to unwind.

item.title: Meta sinks 8%, continuing record losing streak, while Microsoft jumps 15% as AI trade splits
item.description: Microsoft posted strong Azure and Copilot growth, while Meta missed revenue guidance forecasts as free cash flow plunged leading to diverging stock moves.

item.title: CNBC Select’s weekly mortgage rate snapshot: See your options today
item.description: Here are the mortgage rates are for the week ending July 30, according to Freddie Mac.

item.title: Anthropic says its Claude models 'gained unauthorized access' to other organizations' systems
item.description: Anthropic said it discovered three instances where its Claude AI models accessed the internet during an evaluation and accessed outside systems.

item.title: Inside India newsletter: Meta's clout in the world's largest democracy is surging — inviting scrutiny
item.description: Meta Platforms has strengthened its influence on India as Gen Z protesters widely relied on Instagram to raise their concerns against the Modi government.

item.title: Nexus Data Centers in advanced talks to secure $15B for Google-backed Anthropic data center
item.description: Morgan Stanley is the lead banker engaging in advanced talks to lend $15 billion to Nexus Data Centers, CNBC confirmed.

item.title: Rivian reduces 2026 spending plans, narrows earnings guidance
item.description: Rivian reduced its 2026 spending plans and slightly narrowed its previously forecast losses this year as the company reported second-quarter results.

item.title: Jersey Mike's stock falls 6% in public market debut after pricing shares at $23
item.description: Jersey Mike's priced its initial public offering at $23 per share.

item.title: Jim Cramer says this hedge fund's blowup reveals the hidden risks of leverage
item.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer said the forced unwind of Situational Awareness shows how borrowing money can quickly magnify losses and trigger forced selling.

item.title: Indonesian state telecom said to weigh sale of venture arm managing $830 million
item.description: Indonesia's state-owned telecom giant is exploring a sale of MDI Ventures, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: China’s open-weight model lead exposes America’s AI blind spot
item.description: The future of AI may be dictated not by who builds the smartest model, but who builds the models everyone runs on. Right now, that's China.
